headline: Bessent: IRGC Leaders 'Trapped' Like 'Drowning Rats' By US Blockade, Will Soon Face Uprising Over Coming 'Gasoline Shortages Next'
summary: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said IRGC leaders are trapped by the US blockade and will face gasoline shortages. Iran's latest offer centres on lifting the blockade of its ports.
why: Disruptions to Iranian oil exports and Gulf shipping routes can move crude oil prices and global energy markets.
why_moved: The US blockade of Iranian ports and Iran's offer to lift it are central to the reported developments. Shipping and supply risks in the Gulf are the main channel for oil prices.
